author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Azahar 2126.0-rc3: official release candidate
summary: Azahar published 2126.0-rc3 on July 14, 2026. The release record documents an official release candidate for the Nintendo 3DS emulator project.

blocks.text: The Azahar project published version 2126.0-rc3 on July 14, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The official notes highlight the following changes: When using multiplayer rooms, it is now possible to set "No Preference" as the preferred game. @PabloMK7 2296. Also fixes crashes when creating or joining private multiplayer rooms on Android when the preferred game option is left untouched. Fixed a crash which could occur when an application submits a vertex array with an invalid base address. @PabloMK7 2299. Known to fix a crash in the credits of Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga. May fix other problems elsewhere.
